_doc: E00: test assets (fictional brand TIDEWATER). 2 variants each, Claude picks the best into ../assets/<id>.png | run note: token-priced model, est_usd=0.30/take is a declared ceiling; 1 take each (A1 kept from probe).

args.prompt: Studio packshot of a single slim 12oz aluminum drink can standing upright on a seamless pale-sand backdrop, soft key light from the left, gentle contact shadow. The can is matte turquoise with a white horizontal band; on the band the word "TIDEWATER" in bold black condensed sans-serif capitals, centered; below it smaller text "ELECTROLYTE WATER". Clean silver top. Photorealistic commercial product photography, 85mm, the whole can visible with space around it. No other objects, no extra text.

A glossy double cheeseburger on a dark walnut table in a warm diner, melted cheddar dripping over the patty, sesame bun, a few fries beside it, steam rising, warm practical light from the right, shallow depth of field, photorealistic food photography, 70mm. No people, no text, no logos.

Head-and-shoulders portrait of a friendly woman in her early 30s with curly dark hair, light freckles, natural skin texture with visible pores, no makeup look, white linen shirt, standing on a sunny Florida porch with palm leaves softly blurred behind her, warm late-afternoon light from the left, looking straight into the lens with a slight smile, 50mm, photorealistic. No text.

Extreme macro of a clear glass serum dropper bottle with a black rubber pipette on a wet white marble surface, a single golden drop hanging from the pipette tip, soft diffused top light, tiny highlights, photorealistic cosmetic product photography, 100mm macro. No text, no labels.

Wide shot of a sunny palm-lined street in Boca Raton, Florida at midday: pastel Mediterranean-style shops, white sidewalks, a few parked cars, clear blue sky, hard shadows, eye-level 24mm, photorealistic. An empty area in the middle of the street. No people close to camera, no text, no logos.
